race.comment: AFIREOFGIDGEECOALS (1) flew home to just miss fresh before sitting wide and being gunned down as the $1.40 favourite in the Prelude. Things look to work out much nicer for him here however and the blinkers being reapplied should help. Can go one better now. ONE LAST RESORT (10) was very impressive out to 1200m at Belmont when running away and winning in good time. This is tougher, but he hinted that he's a horse on the rise and this looks to shape favourably from a favourable barrier. Looks to have a high ceiling and can make an impression. I want to keep COS I AM (13) safe as she's had absolutely no chance in her two runs back. She looked ready to slice through in the Belgravia last start before being chopped out at a crucial stage. Thinking we haven't seen the best of her yet and with a touch of luck, she can feature. ACHY BREAKY (11) was good fresh in the Belgravia and has claims here with the blinkers on. LEVATI DIMEZZO (4) beat AFIREOFGIDGEECOALS last start and has to be included.
